RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 45

An all-male panel increases the risk of implicit bias, especially when subjective criteria like "leadership" outweigh your doctoral degree and section-head tenure. However, broad management experience is a legitimate qualification for department head roles, so panel composition alone does not prove sex discrimination.

Do not lead with an accusation of bias. First, follow up firmly on your requested written feedback. Check whether hospital recruitment guidelines mandate diverse interview panels; if so, you can raise procedural non-compliance neutrally. If the feedback is vague or reveals shifting standards, consult an employment lawyer or union representative before raising discrimination.
